title: AISE capture upload result (v1.0)
description: Server acknowledgement for one logical upload. ACCEPTED means the bytes were newly stored. DUPLICATE means the same logical upload (same idempotency key and same content hash) was already received; the retry succeeds without creating a second logical asset (requirements AC-012). Conditional enforcement: when outcome is DUPLICATE, duplicateOf is REQUIRED and identifies the original logical asset — a DUPLICATE acknowledgement without it is invalid, because the client could not reconcile the retried upload with the already-stored asset. ACCEPTED carries no duplicateOf obligation.

outcome.title: Logical upload outcome (never an error for idempotent retries)

receivedHash.title: Server-computed hash of the stored bytes

duplicateOf.title: Original logical asset id (required when outcome is DUPLICATE)
